Calculate the living population at time points

Source: R/calc_demographic_measures.R
calculate_population_size.Rd

Count persons with birth_time <= time and missing death_time or death_time > time. Counts include births at the requested time and exclude deaths at that time, representing the population after recorded events there. Results preserve the order of the requested times, including repeated times.

Usage

calculate_population_size(population, times, by_group = FALSE)

Arguments

population

A hammel_population or persons data frame representing one independent history. For bare tables, ensure follow-up is complete through every requested time.

times

A numeric vector of finite time points in years. A population object cannot be queried beyond its known end_time.

by_group

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, require a persons group column and count separately by group. Groups retain their input type and first-occurrence order within each requested time. No pooled group row is added. Empty histories return a typed zero-row table.

Value

A tibble with time and population columns, plus group when by_group = TRUE.

Examples

population <- create_baseline_population(100, end_time = 0)
calculate_population_size(population, times = c(-10, -5, 0))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>    time population
#>   <dbl>      <int>
#> 1   -10         90
#> 2    -5         95
#> 3     0        100
